DESCRIPTION_EN: Abrasive blasting operators use the proper equipment and machinery to smoothen rough surfaces by abrasive blasting. Abrasive blasting is commonly used in the finishing process of metal workpieces and for blasting building materials used in masonry such as bricks, stones and concrete. They operate blasters or sand cabinets which forcibly thrust a stream of abrasive material such sand, soda or water, under high pressure, propelled by a centrifigal wheel, in order to shape and smoothen surfaces.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Waendeshaji wa usafishaji kwa mchanga hutumia vifaa na mashine zinazofaa ili kulainisha nyuso zenye ukwaru kwa usafishaji wa kukwaruza. Usafishaji kwa mchanga hutumiwa kwa kawaida katika mchakato wa kumalizia vipande vya chuma na kwa kusafisha vifaa vya ujenzi vinavyotumiwa katika uashi kama vile matofali, mawe na zege. Wanatunza mashine za kupuliza au kabati za mchanga ambazo hurusha kwa nguvu mkondo wa nyenzo za kukwaruza kama mchanga, soda au maji, chini ya shinikizo la juu, ikisukumwa na gurudumu la sentrifigali, ili kuunda na kulainisha nyuso.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Sandblasting operators use appropriate tools and machines to smooth rough surfaces by abrasive blasting. Sandblasting is commonly used in the process of finishing metal parts and for cleaning building materials used in masonry such as bricks, stones, and concrete. They maintain blasting machines or sand cabinets that forcefully propel a stream of abrasive material such as sand, soda, or water, under high pressure, propelled by a centrifugal wheel, to create and smooth surfaces.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Precision engineers design processes, machines, fixtures and other equipment that have exceptionally low engineering tolerances, are repeatable and stable over time. They ensure prototypes are built and tested and make sure the designs meet system specifications and operational requirements.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wahandisi wa usahihi hubuni michakato, mashine, vifaa vya kurekebishia na vifaa vingine ambavyo vina uvumilivu wa chini sana wa uhandisi, vinavyoweza kurudiwa na thabiti kwa muda mrefu. Wanahakikisha mifano ya awali inajengwa na kufanyiwa majaribio na kuhakikisha miundo inakidhi vipimo vya mfumo na mahitaji ya uendeshaji.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Precision engineers design processes, machines, fixtures, and other equipment that have very low engineering tolerances, are repeatable, and stable over time. They ensure that prototypes are built and tested and that designs meet system specifications and operational requirements.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Leather production managers plan all aspects of the leather production process. They ensure the required output of the factory in terms of quality and quantity of the leather. They organise the production staff. They monitor and ensure the operation of machinery and equipment. They cooperate with managers of each production department.

Wanapanga wafanyakazi wa uzalishaji. Wanafuatilia na kuhakikisha uendeshaji wa mitambo na vifaa. Wanashirikiana na mameneja wa kila idara ya uzalishaji.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Leather production managers plan all aspects of the leather production process. They ensure the desired factory output in terms of quality and quantity of leather. They organize production staff. They monitor and ensure the operation of machinery and equipment. They collaborate with managers of each production department.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Copy editors ascertain that a text is agreeable to read. They ensure that a text adheres to the conventions of grammar and spelling. Copy editors read and revise materials for books, journals, magazines and other media.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wahariri wa nakala huhakikisha kuwa maandishi yanavutia kusoma. Wanahakikisha kuwa maandishi yanazingatia kanuni za sarufi na tahajia. Wahariri wa nakala husoma na kurekebisha nyenzo za vitabu, majarida na vyombo vingine vya habari.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Copy editors ensure that texts are engaging to read. They ensure that texts adhere to grammar and spelling rules. Copy editors read and revise materials for books, magazines, and other media.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Digital forensics experts retrieve and analyse information from computers and other types of data storage devices. They examine digital media that may have been hidden, encrypted or damaged, in a forensic manner with the aim to identify, preserve, recover, analyse and present facts and opinions about the digital information.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wataalamu wa uchunguzi wa kidijitali hurejesha na kuchambua habari kutoka kwa kompyuta na aina nyingine za vifaa vya kuhifadhi data. Wanachunguza vyombo vya habari vya kidijitali ambavyo vinaweza kuwa vimefichwa, kusimbwa au kuharibiwa, kwa njia ya kiuchunguzi kwa lengo la kutambua, kuhifadhi, kurejesha, kuchambua na kuwasilisha ukweli na maoni kuhusu habari za kidijitali.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Digital forensics specialists recover and analyze information from computers and other types of data storage devices. They forensically examine digital media that may have been hidden, encrypted, or damaged, with the aim of identifying, preserving, recovering, analyzing, and presenting facts and opinions about digital information.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Activism officers promote or hinder social, political, economic or environmental change by using different tactics such as persuasive research, media pressure or public campaigning.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Maafisa wa harakati huchochea au huzuia mabadiliko ya kijamii, kisiasa, kiuchumi au kimazingira kwa kutumia mbinu tofauti kama vile utafiti wa kushawishi, shinikizo la vyombo vya habari au kampeni za umma.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Campaign officers stimulate or prevent social, political, economic, or environmental changes using different methods such as lobbying research, media pressure, or public campaigns.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Power distribution engineers design and operate facilities which distribute power from the distribution facility to the consumers. They research methods for the optimisation of power distribution, and ensure the consumers' needs are met. They also ensure compliance to safety regulations by monitoring the automated processes in plants and directing workflow.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wahandisi wa usambazaji wa umeme hubuni na kuendesha vituo vinavyosambaza umeme kutoka kituo cha usambazaji hadi kwa walaji. Wanatafiti mbinu za kuboresha usambazaji wa umeme, na kuhakikisha mahitaji ya walaji yanatimizwa. Pia wanahakikisha uzingatiaji wa kanuni za usalama kwa kufuatilia michakato ya kiotomatiki katika mitambo na kuelekeza mtiririko wa kazi.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Power distribution engineers design and operate facilities that distribute electricity from the distribution station to consumers. They research methods to improve electricity distribution and ensure consumer needs are met. They also ensure compliance with safety regulations by monitoring automated processes in plants and directing workflow.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Groundwater monitoring technician monitor the environment, gathering data in the form of samples and performing tests in a laboratory or field, to investigate potential sources of pollution. They also perform maintenance tasks on the monitoring equipment.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Mafundi ufuatiliaji wa maji ya ardhini hufuatilia mazingira, wakikusanya data kwa njia ya sampuli na kufanya vipimo katika maabara au nyanjani, ili kuchunguza vyanzo vinavyoweza kusababisha uchafuzi. Pia hufanya kazi za matengenezo kwenye vifaa vya ufuatiliaji.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Groundwater monitoring technicians monitor the environment, collecting data through sampling and conducting tests in the laboratory or in the field, to investigate potential sources of contamination. They also perform maintenance tasks on monitoring equipment.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Millers tend mills to grind cereal crops to obtain flour. They regulate the flow of materials that go into mills and adjust the grind to a specified fineness. They ensure basic maintenance and cleaning of equipments. They evaluate sample of product to verify fineness of grind.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wasagaji huendesha vinu ili kusaga mazao ya nafaka ili kupata unga. Wanadhibiti mtiririko wa vifaa vinavyoingia kwenye vinu na kurekebisha usagaji kwa ulaini maalum. Wanahakikisha matengenezo ya kimsingi na usafishaji wa vifaa. Wanatathmini sampuli ya bidhaa ili kuhakiki ulaini wa usagaji.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Millers operate mills to grind grain products to obtain flour. They control the flow of materials entering the mills and adjust the grinding for specific fineness. They ensure basic maintenance and cleaning of equipment. They evaluate product samples to verify the fineness of the grind.

DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Refers to activities related to attending to furnaces, boilers, and kilns for heating and water supply.

PREFERREDLABEL_SW: mfanyakazi wa kumimina chuma kwenye kalibu ya chuma (coquille)
PREFERREDLABEL_BACK_EN: metal pourer into a metal mold (coquille)
DESCRIPTION_EN: Coquille casting workers manufacture castings, including pipes, tubes, hollow profiles and other products of the first processing of steel, by operating hand-controlled equipment in a foundry. They conduct the flow of molten ferrous and non-ferrous metals into coquilles, taking care to create the exact right circumstances to obtain the highest quality metal. They observe the flow of metal to identify faults. In case of a fault, they notify the authorised personnel and participate in the removal of the fault.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wafanyakazi wa kumimina chuma kwenye kalibu ya chuma (coquille) hutengeneza bidhaa za chuma zilizomiminwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na mabomba, tyubu, wasifu wenye uwazi na bidhaa nyingine za usindikaji wa kwanza wa chuma, kwa kuendesha vifaa vinavyodhibitiwa kwa mkono katika kiwanda cha kuyeyusha chuma. Wanaongoza mtiririko wa metali za ferasi na zisizo za ferasi zilizoyeyushwa kwenye kalibu za chuma (coquilles), wakizingatia kuweka mazingira sahihi kabisa ili kupata chuma cha ubora wa juu zaidi. Wanatazama mtiririko wa chuma ili kutambua hitilafu. Ikitokea hitilafu, hutoa taarifa kwa wafanyakazi walioidhinishwa na kushiriki katika kuondoa hitilafu hiyo.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Workers who pour metal into metal molds (coquilles) produce cast metal products, including pipes, tubes, hollow profiles, and other primary metal processing products, by operating manually controlled equipment in a metal foundry. They guide the flow of molten ferrous and non-ferrous metals into metal molds (coquilles), ensuring the maintenance of precise conditions to obtain the highest quality metal. They monitor the metal flow to identify defects. If a defect occurs, they report it to authorized personnel and participate in resolving the defect.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Contact centre managers coordinate and plan the daily operations of contact centres. They ensure that customer inquiries are satisfied efficiently and according to policies. They manage employees, resources and procedures to improve best practices and achieve high levels of customer satisfaction.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wameneja wa vituo vya mawasiliano huratibu na kupanga shughuli za kila siku za vituo vya mawasiliano. Wanahakikisha kuwa maswali ya wateja yanajibiwa kwa ufanisi na kulingana na sera. Wanasimamia wafanyakazi, rasilimali na taratibu ili kuboresha mbinu bora na kufikia viwango vya juu vya kuridhika kwa wateja.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Contact center managers coordinate and plan the daily operations of contact centers. They ensure that customer inquiries are answered efficiently and in accordance with policies. They manage staff, resources, and procedures to improve best practices and achieve high levels of customer satisfaction.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Carpet weavers operate machinery to create textile floor coverings. They create carpets and rugs from wool or synthetic textiles using specialised equipment. Carpet weavers can use diverse methods such as weaving, knotting or tufting to create carpets of different styles.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wasukaji wa mazulia huendesha mitambo ili kuunda vifuniko vya sakafu vya nguo. Wanatengeneza mazulia na mikeka kutoka kwa sufu au nguo za sintetiki kwa kutumia vifaa maalum. Wasukaji wa mazulia wanaweza kutumia mbinu mbalimbali kama vile kusuka, kufunga mafundo au kuweka vishada ili kuunda mazulia ya mitindo tofauti.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Carpet weavers operate machines to create textile floor coverings. They produce carpets and rugs from wool or synthetic fabrics using specialized equipment. Carpet weavers can use various techniques such as weaving, knotting, or tufting to create carpets of different styles.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Lifeguard instructors teach future (professional) lifeguards the necessary programmes and methods needed to become a licensed lifeguard. They provide training on safety supervision of all swimmers, assessment of potentially hazardous situations, rescue-specific swimming and diving techniques, first aid treatment for swimming-related injuries, and they inform students on preventative lifeguard responsibilities. They ensure students are aware of the importance of checking safe water quality, heeding risk management and being aware of the necessary protocols and regulations regarding lifeguarding and rescuing. They monitor the students' progress, evaluate them through theoretical and practical tests and award the lifeguard licenses when obtained.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wakufunzi wa walinzi wa maisha huwafundisha walinzi wa maisha wa baadaye (wataalamu) programu na mbinu muhimu zinazohitajika ili kuwa mlinzi wa maisha aliyeidhinishwa. Wanatoa mafunzo juu ya usimamizi wa usalama wa waogeleaji wote, tathmini ya hali zinazoweza kuwa hatari, mbinu maalum za uokoaji za kuogelea na kupiga mbizi, matibabu ya huduma ya kwanza kwa majeraha yanayohusiana na kuogelea, na huwafahamisha wanafunzi kuhusu majukumu ya kuzuia ya walinzi wa maisha. Wanahakikisha wanafunzi wanafahamu umuhimu wa kuangalia ubora wa maji salama, kuzingatia usimamizi wa hatari na kufahamu itifaki na kanuni muhimu kuhusu ulinzi wa maisha na uokoaji. Wanafuatilia maendeleo ya wanafunzi, wanawafanyia tathmini kupitia majaribio ya kinadharia na ya vitendo na kutoa leseni za ulinzi wa maisha zinapopatikana.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Lifeguard instructors teach prospective lifeguards (professionals) the essential programs and techniques required to become a certified lifeguard. They provide training on the safety management of all swimmers, assessment of potentially dangerous situations, specific swimming and diving rescue techniques, first aid treatment for swimming-related injuries, and inform students about the preventative duties of lifeguards. They ensure students understand the importance of checking for safe water quality, adhering to risk management, and comprehending key protocols and regulations regarding lifeguarding and rescue. They monitor student progress, evaluate them through theoretical and practical tests, and issue lifeguard licenses when available.

PREFERREDLABEL_SW: meneja wa maendeleo ya bidhaa za viatu
DESCRIPTION_EN: Footwear product development managers coordinate the footwear design and the product and collection development process in order to comply with design specifications, deadlines, strategic requirements and policies of the company. They track style development and review design specifications in order to meet the design vision, the manufacturing environment, and the company’s financial goals.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Mameneja wa maendeleo ya bidhaa za viatu wanaratibu muundo wa viatu na mchakato wa maendeleo ya bidhaa na mkusanyiko ili kuzingatia vipimo vya muundo, tarehe za mwisho, mahitaji ya kimkakati na sera za kampuni. Wanafuatilia maendeleo ya mtindo na kupitia vipimo vya muundo ili kufikia maono ya muundo, mazingira ya utengenezaji, na malengo ya kifedha ya kampuni.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Footwear product development managers coordinate footwear design and the product development and collection process to adhere to design specifications, deadlines, strategic requirements, and company policies. They monitor fashion trends and review design specifications to achieve the company's design vision, manufacturing environment, and financial goals.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Communication managers are responsible for developing communication strategies in order to promote the organization's mission, services or product. They coordinate communication projects and manage the communications issued by the company for both the internal and the external clients. They supervise internal communications, ensuring that communications reach each one of the employees and further questions can be answered. For external communications, they coordinate coherence among the messages transmitted in mails, printed materials, press articles, and corporate promotional materials. They strive to maintain truthful communications.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Mameneja wa mawasiliano wanawajibika kwa kuandaa mikakati ya mawasiliano ili kukuza dhamira, huduma au bidhaa ya shirika. Wanaratibu miradi ya mawasiliano na kusimamia mawasiliano yanayotolewa na kampuni kwa wateja wa ndani na nje. Wanasimamia mawasiliano ya ndani, wakihakikisha kuwa mawasiliano yanamfikia kila mmoja wa wafanyakazi na maswali zaidi yanaweza kujibiwa. Kwa mawasiliano ya nje, wanaratibu uwiano kati ya ujumbe unaotumwa katika barua, vifaa vilivyochapishwa, makala za vyombo vya habari, na vifaa vya kukuza shirika. Wanajitahidi kudumisha mawasiliano ya kweli.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Communications managers are responsible for preparing communication strategies to promote an organization's mission, services, or products. They coordinate communication projects and manage communications issued by the company to internal and external clients. They manage internal communications, ensuring that communications reach every employee and further questions can be answered. For external communications, they coordinate consistency between messages sent in letters, printed materials, media articles, and organizational promotional materials. They strive to maintain truthful communication.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Hydrogeologists in mining study the distribution, quality and flow of water in order to keep mine workings free of nuisance water and to ensure an adequate supply of process water. They supply and evaluate information which will protect ground and surface water from contamination.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wanahajidro-jiolojia katika uchimbaji madini huchunguza usambazaji, ubora na mtiririko wa maji ili kuweka maeneo ya kazi ya migodini bila maji yanayosumbua na kuhakikisha usambazaji wa kutosha wa maji ya mchakato. Wanatoa na kutathmini taarifa ambazo zitalinda maji ya chini ya ardhi na ya juu dhidi ya uchafuzi.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Hydrogeologists in mining investigate the distribution, quality, and flow of water to keep mine work areas free from problematic water and ensure an adequate supply of process water. They provide and evaluate information that will protect groundwater and surface water from contamination.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Admissions coordinators are in charge of the students' applications and admissions to a (private) school, college or university. They assess possible future students' qualifications and subsequently approve or deny their application, based on the regulations and desires set by the board of directors and the school administration. They also assist the accepted students in their enrollment in the programme and courses of their choice.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Waratibu wa udahili wanasimamia maombi na udahili wa wanafunzi katika shule (ya binafsi), chuo au chuo kikuu. Wanatathmini sifa za wanafunzi watarajiwa na baadaye kuidhinisha au kukataa maombi yao, kulingana na kanuni na matakwa yaliyowekwa na bodi ya wakurugenzi na uongozi wa shule. Pia huwasaidia wanafunzi waliokubaliwa katika kujiandikisha kwenye programu na kozi wanazochagua.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Admissions coordinators manage student applications and admissions at a (private) school, college, or university. They evaluate the qualifications of prospective students and subsequently approve or reject their applications, according to the rules and requirements set by the board of directors and school administration. They also assist admitted students in enrolling in their chosen programs and courses.

DESCRIPTION_EN: User interface developers implement, code, document and maintain the interface of a software system by using front-end development technologies.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Waendelezaji wa kiolesura cha mtumiaji hutekeleza, kuandika msimbo, kuandika nyaraka na kudumisha kiolesura cha mfumo wa programu kwa kutumia teknolojia za uendelezaji wa upande wa mbele.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: User interface developers implement, code, document, and maintain the interface of a software system using front-end development technologies.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Electric meter technicians install and maintain electric meter systems in facilities or buildings. They install the equipment in accordance with regulations and repair faults and other problems. They test the equipment and advise on the use and care.

DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Electricity meter specialists install and maintain electricity meter systems in stations or buildings. They install equipment according to regulations and repair faults and other problems. They test equipment and provide advice on use and maintenance.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Footwear quality managers implement, manage and promote the quality systems in the company, using adequate tools and methodologies based on national, international or company standards. They are in charge of establishing requirements and objectives, as well as preparing documents. They analyse complaints, and promote and coordinate corrective and preventive measures. They promote an effective internal and external communication and ensure the consumer's demands are met. They are responsible for the definition of instruments which monitor and control the quality systems, namely internal or external auditing, and they participate in the internal auditing.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Meneja wa ubora wa viatu hutekeleza, kusimamia na kuendeleza mifumo ya ubora katika kampuni, kwa kutumia zana na mbinu za kutosha kulingana na viwango vya kitaifa, kimataifa au vya kampuni. Anahusika na kuweka mahitaji na malengo, pamoja na kuandaa nyaraka. Huchambua malalamiko, na kuendeleza na kuratibu hatua za kurekebisha na kuzuia. Huendeleza mawasiliano madhubuti ya ndani na nje na kuhakikisha mahitaji ya mlaji yanatimizwa. Anahusika na ufafanuzi wa vyombo vinavyofuatilia na kudhibiti mifumo ya ubora, yaani ukaguzi wa ndani au wa nje, na hushiriki katika ukaguzi wa ndani.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Footwear quality managers implement, manage, and develop quality systems in a company, using appropriate tools and methods according to national, international, or company standards. They are responsible for setting requirements and objectives, as well as preparing documentation. They analyze complaints, and develop and coordinate corrective and preventive actions. They develop effective internal and external communication and ensure customer requirements are met. They are responsible for defining the instruments that monitor and control quality systems, i.e., internal or external audits, and participate in internal audits.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Tyre fitters inspect, maintain, repair and fit tyres to vehicles. They advise clients on different tyre and wheel types. Furthermore they balance the tyres, verify that the wheels are aligned correctly and ensure compliance with safety standards and regulations.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wafungaji wa matairi hukagua, kudumisha, kukarabati na kufunga matairi kwenye magari. Wanawashauri wateja kuhusu aina tofauti za matairi na magurudumu. Aidha, wanasawazisha matairi, wanahakikisha kuwa magurudumu yamepangiliwa kwa usahihi na kuhakikisha uzingatiaji wa viwango na kanuni za usalama.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Tire fitters inspect, maintain, repair, and install tires on vehicles. They advise customers on different types of tires and wheels. Additionally, they balance tires, ensure wheels are correctly aligned, and ensure compliance with safety standards and regulations.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Corporate risk managers identify and assess potential threats and opportunities to a company, and give advice on how to deal with them. They create preventive plans to avoid and reduce risks, and put plans in place for when the company is threatened. They coordinate risk management aspects across the different functions of an organisation and are responsible for technical activities such as risk assessment, risk mapping and insurance purchase. They report on risk issues to the senior management and the company's board.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Mameneja wa hatari za shirika hutambua na kutathmini vitisho na fursa zinazoweza kutokea kwa kampuni, na kutoa ushauri wa jinsi ya kukabiliana nazo. Wanaunda mipango ya kuzuia ili kuepuka na kupunguza hatari, na kuweka mipango wakati kampuni inatishiwa. Wanaratibu vipengele vya usimamizi wa hatari katika kazi mbalimbali za shirika na wanawajibika kwa shughuli za kiufundi kama vile tathmini ya hatari, ramani ya hatari na ununuzi wa bima. Wanatoa ripoti kuhusu masuala ya hatari kwa usimamizi mkuu na bodi ya kampuni.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Corporate risk managers identify and assess potential threats and opportunities for a company, and provide advice on how to deal with them. They create prevention plans to avoid and mitigate risks, and establish plans when the company is threatened. They coordinate risk management aspects across various organizational functions and are responsible for technical activities such as risk assessment, risk mapping, and insurance procurement. They report on risk issues to senior management and the company board.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Aircraft groomers clean aircraft cabins and airplanes after usage. They vacuum or sweep the interior of cabin, brush debris from seats, and arrange seat belts. They clean trash and debris from seat pockets and arranged in-flight magazines, safety cards, and sickness bags. They also clean galleys and lavatories.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wasafishaji wa ndege husafisha vyumba vya ndege na eropleni baada ya matumizi. Wananyonya vumbi au kufagia mambo ya ndani ya kabati, kupiga brashi uchafu kutoka kwenye viti, na kupanga mikanda ya usalama. Wanasafisha takataka na uchafu kutoka kwenye mifuko ya viti na kupanga majarida ya ndani ya ndege, kadi za usalama, na mifuko ya kichefuchefu. Pia wanasafisha jikoni na vyoo.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Aircraft cleaners clean aircraft cabins and airplanes after use. They vacuum or sweep the interior of the cabin, brush debris from seats, and arrange seat belts. They clean trash and debris from seat pockets and arrange in-flight magazines, safety cards, and airsickness bags. They also clean galleys and lavatories.

PREFERREDLABEL_SW: opereta wa mashine ya kukunja plastiki
DESCRIPTION_EN: Plastic rolling machine operators operate and monitor machines to produce plastic rolls, or to flatten and reduce the material. They examine raw materials and finished products to make sure they are according to specifications.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Waendeshaji wa mashine ya kukunja plastiki huendesha na kufuatilia mashine za kuzalisha maroli ya plastiki, au kusawazisha na kupunguza nyenzo. Wanachunguza malighafi na bidhaa zilizokamilika ili kuhakikisha kuwa ziko kulingana na maelezo.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Plastic folding machine operators operate and monitor machines that produce plastic rolls, or straighten and reduce materials. They inspect raw materials and finished products to ensure they conform to specifications.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Control panel assemblers read schematic drawings to assemble control panel units for electrical equipment. They put together wiring, switches, control and measuring apparatus and cables with hand operated tools.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wafunganishaji wa paneli za udhibiti husoma michoro ya skematiki ili kuunganisha uniti za paneli za udhibiti kwa ajili ya vifaa vya umeme. Wanaunganisha nyaya, swichi, vifaa vya kudhibiti na kupimia pamoja na nyaya kwa kutumia zana zinazoendeshwa kwa mkono.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Control panel assemblers read schematic diagrams to assemble control panel units for electrical equipment. They connect wires, switches, control and measuring devices, and cables using hand-operated tools.

PREFERREDLABEL_SW: mfanyakazi wa kiwanda cha kuyeyusha chuma
DESCRIPTION_EN: Foundry operative manufacture castings, including pipes, tubes, hollow profiles and other products of the first processing of steel, by operating hand-controlled equipment in a foundry. They conduct the flow of molten ferrous and non-ferrous metals into moulds, taking care to create the exact right circumstances to obtain the highest quality metal. They observe the flow of metal to identify faults. In case of a fault, they notify the authorised personnel and participate in the removal of the fault.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wafanyakazi wa kiwanda cha kuyeyusha chuma hutengeneza bidhaa za chuma zilizomiminwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na mabomba, tyubu, wasifu wenye uwazi na bidhaa nyingine za usindikaji wa kwanza wa chuma, kwa kuendesha vifaa vinavyodhibitiwa kwa mkono katika kiwanda cha kuyeyusha chuma. Wanaongoza mtiririko wa metali za ferasi na zisizo za ferasi zilizoyeyushwa kwenye kalibu, wakizingatia kuweka mazingira sahihi kabisa ili kupata chuma cha ubora wa juu zaidi. Wanatazama mtiririko wa chuma ili kutambua hitilafu. Ikitokea hitilafu, hutoa taarifa kwa wafanyakazi walioidhinishwa na kushiriki katika kuondoa hitilafu hiyo.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Iron foundry workers produce cast iron products, including pipes, tubes, hollow profiles, and other primary iron processing products, by operating manually controlled equipment in an iron foundry. They guide the flow of molten ferrous and non-ferrous metals into molds, ensuring the precise environment is maintained to obtain the highest quality iron. They monitor the flow of metal to identify defects. If a defect occurs, they report it to authorized personnel and participate in resolving the defect.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Consumer rights advisors aid consumers with complaints and provide advice and information on rights as a consumer after purchase of products or services. They monitor organisations to ensure compliance to consumer rights standards, and aid consumers in handling disputes.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Washauri wa haki za mlaji huwasaidia walaji wenye malalamiko na kutoa ushauri na taarifa kuhusu haki kama mlaji baada ya kununua bidhaa au huduma. Wanazifuatilia mashirika ili kuhakikisha uzingatiaji wa viwango vya haki za mlaji, na kuwasaidia walaji katika kushughulikia migogoro.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Consumer rights advisors help consumers with complaints and provide advice and information about consumer rights after purchasing goods or services. They monitor organizations to ensure compliance with consumer rights standards and assist consumers in resolving disputes.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Human resources officers develop and implement strategies that help their employers select and retain appropriately qualified staff within that business sector. They recruit staff, prepare job advertisements, interview and short-list people, negotiate with employment agencies, and set up working conditions. Human resources officers also administer the payroll, review salaries and advise on remuneration benefits and employment law. They arrange for training opportunities to enhance employees' performance.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Maafisa wa rasilimali watu huandaa na kutekeleza mikakati inayosaidia waajiri wao kuchagua na kubakiza wafanyakazi wenye sifa zinazostahili ndani ya sekta hiyo ya biashara. Wanaajiri wafanyakazi, kuandaa matangazo ya kazi, kuhoji na kuchuja watu, kujadiliana na mawakala wa ajira, na kuweka mazingira ya kazi. Maafisa wa rasilimali watu pia husimamia malipo, kupitia mishahara na kushauri kuhusu faida za malipo na sheria ya ajira. Wanapanga fursa za mafunzo ili kuboresha utendaji wa wafanyakazi.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Human resources officers prepare and implement strategies that help their employers select and retain qualified employees within that business sector. They recruit employees, prepare job advertisements, interview and screen candidates, negotiate with employment agencies, and establish working environments. Human resources officers also manage compensation, review salaries, and advise on benefits and employment law. They plan training opportunities to improve employee performance.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Stage machinists manipulate sets and other elements in a performance based on the artistic or creative concept, in interaction with the performers. Their work is influenced by and influences the results of other operators. Therefore, the stage machinists work closely together with the designers, operators and performers. Stage machinists prepare and perform the setup, execute changeovers and operate manual fly bar systems. Their work is based on plans, instructions and calculations.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Mafundi mitambo wa jukwaa huendesha seti na vipengele vingine katika onyesho kulingana na dhana ya kisanii au ubunifu, kwa kushirikiana na waigizaji. Kazi yao huathiriwa na na huathiri matokeo ya waendeshaji wengine. Kwa hivyo, mafundi mitambo wa jukwaa hufanya kazi kwa karibu na wabunifu, waendeshaji na waigizaji. Mafundi mitambo wa jukwaa huandaa na kufanya usanidi, kutekeleza mabadiliko na kuendesha mifumo ya mikono ya baa za kuruka. Kazi yao inategemea mipango, maelekezo na mahesabu.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Stage technicians operate sets and other elements in a show according to an artistic or creative concept, in collaboration with performers. Their work is influenced by and influences the results of other operators. Therefore, stage technicians work closely with designers, operators, and performers. Stage technicians prepare and perform setups, implement changes, and operate manual flying bar systems. Their work relies on plans, instructions, and calculations.

PREFERREDLABEL_SW: opereta wa mashine ya kushona vitabu
DESCRIPTION_EN: Book-sewing machine operators tend a machine that stitches paper together to form a volume. They check that signatures are inserted the right way and the machine does not jam.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Waendeshaji wa mashine ya kushona vitabu huhudumia mashine inayoshona karatasi pamoja ili kuunda kitabu. Wanakagua kuwa saini zimeingizwa kwa njia sahihi na mashine haikwami.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Book sewing machine operators operate a machine that sews paper together to create a book. They check that signatures are inserted correctly and that the machine does not jam.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Subtitlers can work intralingually, within the same language, or interlingually, across languages. Intralingual subtitlers create the subtitles for hearing-impaired viewers, whereas interlingual subtitlers create the subtitles for movies or television programmes in a different language to the one heard in the audiovisual production. They both ensure that the captions and subtitles are synchronised with the sound, images and dialogue of the audiovisual work.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wataalamu wa manukuu wanaweza kufanya kazi ndani ya lugha moja, au kati ya lugha tofauti. Wataalamu wa manukuu ya lugha moja huunda manukuu kwa ajili ya watazamaji wenye ulemavu wa kusikia, ilhali wataalamu wa manukuu ya lugha tofauti huunda manukuu ya filamu au vipindi vya televisheni katika lugha tofauti na ile inayosikika katika uzalishaji wa sauti na picha. Wote wawili huhakikisha kuwa manukuu yanasawazishwa na sauti, picha na mazungumzo ya kazi ya sauti na picha.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Subtitling specialists can work within one language or between different languages. Single-language subtitling specialists create subtitles for hearing-impaired audiences, while multi-language subtitling specialists create subtitles for films or television programs in a language different from that heard in the audio-visual production. Both ensure that subtitles are synchronized with the sound, image, and dialogue of the audio-visual work.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Strategic planning managers create, together with a team of managers, the strategic plans of the company as a whole, and provide coordination in the implementation per department. They help to interpret the overall plan and create a detailed plan for each one of the departments and branches. They ensure consistency in the implementation.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Meneja wa mipango mkakati huunda, pamoja na timu ya mameneja, mipango mkakati ya kampuni kwa ujumla, na kutoa uratibu katika utekelezaji kwa kila idara. Wanasaidia kutafsiri mpango mkuu na kuunda mpango wa kina kwa kila moja ya idara na matawi. Wanahakikisha uthabiti katika utekelezaji.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Strategic planning managers, together with a team of managers, create strategic plans for the company as a whole and provide coordination in implementation for each department. They help translate the master plan and create a detailed plan for each of the departments and branches. They ensure consistency in implementation.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Specialised doctors prevent, diagnose and treat diseases depending on their medical or surgical specialty.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Madaktari bingwa huzuia, hupima na kutibu magonjwa kulingana na utaalamu wao wa matibabu au upasuaji.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Specialist doctors prevent, diagnose, and treat diseases according to their medical or surgical specialization.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Fibre machine tenders operate and maintain extrusion machines that form sliver from filaments. They work with synthetic materials such as fiberglass or liquid polymer or non-synthetic materials such as rayon.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wasimamizi wa mashine ya nyuzi huendesha na kudumisha mashine za kutoa ambazo hutengeneza kamba kutoka kwa nyuzi ndogo. Wanafanya kazi na vifaa vya sanisi kama vile kioo cha nyuzi au polima ya majimaji au vifaa visivyo vya sanisi kama vile rayoni.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Fiber machine operators operate and maintain extrusion machines that produce ropes from small fibers. They work with synthetic materials such as fiberglass or liquid polymer or non-synthetic materials such as rayon.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Sports instructors introduce people to a sport and teach them the skills required for the performance of sport. They have a strong grip on one or more sports, which are often adventure sports, and know how to motivate others and share with them the enjoyment of the activity.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wakufunzi wa michezo huwatambulisha watu kwenye mchezo na kuwafundisha ujuzi unaohitajika kwa ajili ya utendaji wa mchezo. Wana ujuzi thabiti wa mchezo mmoja au zaidi, ambayo mara nyingi ni michezo ya matukio, na wanajua jinsi ya kuwahamasisha wengine na kushiriki nao furaha ya shughuli hiyo.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Sports instructors introduce people to a sport and teach them the skills needed for game performance. They have a solid knowledge of one or more sports, which are often adventure sports, and they know how to motivate others and share the joy of the activity with them.

PREFERREDLABEL_SW: msimamizi wa kiwanda cha kutengeneza pombe kali
DESCRIPTION_EN: Distillery supervisors coordinate the production processes comprised in the production of spirits and manage the workers engaged in the process. They verify distilled liquors being produced at specified amounts and proofs.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wasimamizi wa kiwanda cha kutengeneza pombe kali huratibu michakato ya uzalishaji inayojumuisha uzalishaji wa vinywaji vikali na kusimamia wafanyakazi wanaohusika katika mchakato huo. Wanahakiki vinywaji vikali vilivyochujwa vinavyozalishwa kwa kiasi na viwango maalum vya kileo.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Distillery managers coordinate production processes involving the production of spirits and supervise the employees involved in the process. They review distilled spirits produced in specific quantities and alcohol levels.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Localisers translate and adapt texts to the language and culture of a specific target audience. They convert standard translation into locally understandable texts with flairs of the culture, sayings, and other nuances that make the translation richer and more meaningful for a cultural target group than it was before.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wataalamu wa ujanibishaji hutafsiri na kurekebisha maandishi kulingana na lugha na utamaduni wa walengwa mahususi. Wanabadilisha tafsiri ya kawaida kuwa maandishi yanayoeleweka ndani ya eneo husika yenye vionjo vya utamaduni, misemo, na maana nyingine fiche zinazofanya tafsiri kuwa tajiri zaidi na yenye maana zaidi kwa kikundi cha kitamaduni kilichokusudiwa kuliko ilivyokuwa hapo awali.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Localization specialists translate and adapt texts according to the language and culture of specific target audiences. They transform standard translations into texts that are understandable within the relevant region, incorporating cultural nuances, idioms, and other hidden meanings that make the translation richer and more meaningful for the intended cultural group than it was previously.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Animal therapists provide a therapeutic treatment following veterinary diagnosis or referral.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wataalamu wa tiba ya wanyama hutoa matibabu ya kibaolojia kufuatia utambuzi wa daktari wa mifugo au rufaa.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Animal therapists provide biological treatments following a veterinary diagnosis or referral.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Healthcare consultants advise health care organisations on the development of plans to improve patient care and safety. They analyse health care policies and identify issues, and aid in the development of improvement strategies.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Washauri wa huduma za afya hushauri mashirika ya huduma za afya kuhusu uandaaji wa mipango ya kuboresha huduma na usalama wa wagonjwa. Wanachambua sera za huduma za afya na kutambua masuala, na kusaidia katika uandaaji wa mikakati ya uboreshaji.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Healthcare consultants advise healthcare organizations on developing plans to improve services and patient safety. They analyze healthcare policies, identify issues, and assist in developing improvement strategies.

PREFERREDLABEL_SW: msimamizi wa ubandikaji wa karatasi za ukutani
DESCRIPTION_EN: Paperhanger supervisors monitor the hanging of wallpaper. They assign tasks and take quick decisions to resolve problems.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wasimamizi wa ubandikaji wa karatasi za ukutani hufuatilia ubandikaji wa karatasi za ukutani. Wanagawa kazi na kufanya maamuzi ya haraka ili kutatua matatizo.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Wallpapering supervisors oversee wallpaper installation. They assign tasks and make quick decisions to resolve problems.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Pharmacologists study the manner in which drugs and medicaments interact with organisms, living systems, and their parts (i.e. cells, tissues, or organs). Their research aims at identifying substances that can be ingested by humans and that exert adequate biochemical functions for curing illnesses.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wanafamajia huchunguza namna ambavyo dawa na matibabu huingiliana na viumbe, mifumo hai, na sehemu zake (yaani seli, tishu, au viungo). Utafiti wao unalenga kutambua dutu zinazoweza kumezwa na binadamu na ambazo hufanya kazi za kibiokemia zinazofaa kwa ajili ya kutibu magonjwa.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Pharmacologists investigate how drugs and treatments interact with organisms, living systems, and their parts (i.e., cells, tissues, or organs). Their research aims to identify substances that can be ingested by humans and perform biochemical functions suitable for treating diseases.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Environmental geologists study how mineral operations may impact the composition and physical characteristics of the earth and its resources. They provide advice on issues such as land reclamation and environmental pollution.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wanajiolojia wa mazingira huchunguza jinsi shughuli za madini zinavyoweza kuathiri muundo na sifa za kifizikia za dunia na maliasili zake. Wanatoa ushauri kuhusu masuala kama vile urejeshaji wa ardhi na uchafuzi wa mazingira.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Environmental geologists investigate how mining activities can affect the structure and physical characteristics of the earth and its natural resources. They provide advice on issues such as land reclamation and environmental pollution.

PREFERREDLABEL_EN: wholesale merchant in flowers and plants
PREFERREDLABEL_SW: mfanyabiashara wa jumla wa maua na mimea
DESCRIPTION_EN: Wholesale merchants in flowers and plants investigate potential wholesale buyers and suppliers and match their needs. They conclude trades involving large quantities of goods.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Wafanyabiashara wa jumla wa maua na mimea huchunguza wanunuzi na wasambazaji wa jumla watarajiwa na kulinganisha mahitaji yao. Wanahitimisha biashara zinazohusisha kiasi kikubwa cha bidhaa.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Flower and plant wholesalers research potential buyers and suppliers and match their needs. They conclude deals involving large quantities of goods.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Forestry advisers provide services and advice on economic and environmental issues related to timber and forestry management in compliance with laws and regulations.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Washauri wa misitu hutoa huduma na ushauri kuhusu masuala ya kiuchumi na kimazingira yanayohusiana na mbao na usimamizi wa misitu kwa kuzingatia sheria na kanuni.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Forestry consultants provide services and advice on economic and environmental issues related to timber and forest management, adhering to laws and regulations.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Optical technicians assemble, repair and design various parts of eyewear such as lenses, frames, patterns and eyewear. They cut, inspect, mount and polish all parts using various machinery and hand tools. Optical technicians shape, grind and coat lenses for prescription eyewear. They fit completed lenses into eyeglass frames. Optical technicians ensure that lenses conform to the dispensing optician’s, specialised doctor in ophtalmology's or optometrist's prescriptions. They may also work with other associated optical instrumentation and its maintenance.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Mafundi wa vifaa vya macho huunganisha, kukarabati na kubuni sehemu mbalimbali za miwani kama vile lenzi, fremu, na mifumo ya miwani. Wanakata, kukagua, kuweka na kusugua sehemu zote kwa kutumia mitambo mbalimbali na zana za mkono. Mafundi wa vifaa vya macho hutengeneza, kusaga na kuweka tabaka kwenye lenzi za miwani ya matibabu. Wanaweka lenzi zilizokamilika kwenye fremu za miwani. Mafundi wa vifaa vya macho huhakikisha kuwa lenzi zinaendana na maelezo ya mtaalamu wa kutoa miwani, daktari bingwa wa magonjwa ya macho au mtaalamu wa uoni. Wanaweza pia kufanya kazi na vifaa vingine vinavyohusiana na macho na matengenezo yake.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Optical technicians assemble, repair, and design various parts of eyeglasses such as lenses, frames, and spectacle systems. They cut, inspect, mount, and polish all parts using various machines and hand tools. Optical technicians manufacture, grind, and coat lenses for prescription eyeglasses. They fit finished lenses into spectacle frames. Optical technicians ensure that lenses match the specifications of an optician, ophthalmologist, or optometrist. They may also work with other eye-related equipment and its maintenance.

DESCRIPTION_EN: Gas station operators process gases for compression, transmission or recovery by using gas, steam or electric engine compressors. They perform chemical tests on gases and are responsible for pumps and pipelines operations.
DESCRIPTION_SW: Waendeshaji wa kituo cha gesi husindika gesi kwa ajili ya mshinikizo, usafirishaji au urejeshaji kwa kutumia mashine za kushinikiza za gesi, mvuke au injini ya umeme. Wanafanya vipimo vya kemikali kwenye gesi na wanawajibika kwa uendeshaji wa pampu na mabomba.
DESCRIPTION_BACK_EN: Gas plant operators process gas for compression, transportation, or recovery using gas, steam, or electric engine compressors. They perform chemical tests on gas and are responsible for operating pumps and pipelines.
